statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-116314 (PostgreSQL pg_restore executes arbitrary code due to missing non-plain archive validation) is fixed upstream in PostgreSQL 16.16. The PostgreSQL security page, https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116314/, lists 16.16 as the fixed release for major version 16, the 16.16 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/16.16/, list this CVE, and the CVE record, https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-116314, lists 16 as affected before 16.16. The fix on the REL_16_STABLE branch is commit https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/cc13d5e0cc77938d94530cb02ec78db1eaecac7d, which changes src/bin/pg_dump/compress_io.c, pg_backup_archiver.c, pg_backup_directory.c and pg_backup_tar.c, carries the trailer "Security: CVE-2026-116314" and is contained in the REL_16_16 tag. Alpine's postgresql16 16.16-r0 on the 3.23-stable branch upgrades to the upstream 16.16 release and lists CVE-2026-116314 under 16.16-r0 in its secfixes: https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/859fa0795e895af033fab32094a83301f2b4d8ff/community/postgresql16/APKBUILD. None of the Alpine patches applied in that APKBUILD change those files. The DHI postgresql16 16.16-r0 package for Alpine 3.23 is built from that APKBUILD and the upstream PostgreSQL 16.16 source tarball, and its postgres server binary reports PostgreSQL 16.16 on both x86_64 and aarch64. pg_restore ships in the postgresql16-client subpackage, built from the same source at the same package version; its pg_restore program reports "pg_restore (PostgreSQL) 16.16" in 16.16-r0 and the matching older 16.x release in each earlier build, on both architectures. Every earlier published build for Alpine 3.23 (16.13-r0, 16.14-r0 and 16.15-r0) is an upstream release before 16.16, and its postgres server binary reports that older 16.x release on both architectures, so it is affected; 16.16-r0 and later carry the fix.

PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-116314, improper validation of non-plain archives in pg_restore, which lets a crafted archive execute code as the user running pg_restore, in 17.12; earlier 17 releases are affected (https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116314/, https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-116314). The server binary in this owner's 17.12-0 build and in its rebuild of Debian's 17.12-0+deb13u1 reports PostgreSQL 17.12 on amd64 and arm64, so both carry the fix. The 17.11-1 build and the current rebuild of Debian's 17.11-0+deb13u1 report PostgreSQL 17.11, and the earlier rebuilds of Debian's 17.10-0+deb13u1 and 17.11-0+deb13u1, no longer in the repository, package PostgreSQL 17.10 and 17.11. All of these are affected and sort below 17.12-0. pg_restore is built from the same source and release as the server.
